answers.reason: The senate decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university, and the description does not assign administration members to it.
Administration members work on the budget in the administration and take part in budget planning.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which is not the domain of administration members.
Faculty councils decide on faculty affairs, which does not involve administration members according to their defined group tasks.
Administration members work on examinations in the administration and handle examination matters.
